messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:patient_data_exposure: Patient-data access or exposure always goes to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Urgent Concern Regarding Lab Result Routing and Privacy

Dear Support Team, we are writing to report a serious workflow issue regarding how incoming diagnostic results are signed off and routed. Earlier today, abnormal lab findings for a patient were inadvertently routed to a covering physician's queue while also appearing on an incorrect viewable list accessible by administrative staff members who should not be seeing such clinical details. We are deeply concerned about this breach of information and need immediate clarification on how to properly isolate abnormal result notifications and restrict sign-off permissions exclusively to licensed medical providers. Please contact us urgently to review our routing configuration and ensure patient data privacy is maintained.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for bringing this serious issue to our attention. We understand your concerns about the routing of abnormal lab results and the privacy implications involved. A member of our support team is reviewing the situation and will be in touch with you to discuss the configuration and next steps.

We appreciate your patience while we investigate this matter.

Best regards,
[Support Team]"
}
